books.title: Jujutsu Kaisen, Vol. 1
books.author: Gege Akutami
books.synopsis: Jujutsu Kaisen follows high schooler Yuji Itadori, who joins a secret society of sorcerers after swallowing a cursed finger and becoming the host to Ryomen Sukuna, the "King of Curses." Monsters called "Curses" are born from human negativity, and only Jujutsu Sorcerers can fight them. To protect his friends, Yuji must hunt down and eat all 20 of Sukuna's rotting fingers so the sorcerers can eventually execute Yuji and destroy the curse forever. He trains at Tokyo Jujutsu High under Satoru Gojo, the world's strongest sorcerer, alongside classmates Megumi and Nobara. However, evil curses and ancient sorcerers plot to seal Gojo away and resurrect Sukuna, leading to a massive, brutal magical war.
